::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru (Hebbal) silicon-IP firm, listed on the Chips-DLI portal (earlier recorded here as 'STT Engineering'). Sells chiplet and memory-interface IP offered at 28 to 12nm.
:::

## What does this firm design?

UCIe, DDR/LPDDR, HBM3E and SerDes PHY IP, plus IO libraries, PLLs and power-management IP.
